title: Islanders MC
description: This server is a new style of Minecraft servers, with it's unique end island generation in the Overworld, it deserves it's name
body:
# Islanders MC

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/hySIJz8WdxQ" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Islanders MC is a smp based server but with skyland generation! Explore the islands, custom structures, spawn island and grind to level up your skills! With npcs, quests and custom elytras, there is endless fun for the endless amounts of islands!
### Elytras

This server is equiped with custom elytras to help get across the island generation. Some are weak while others are powerful beasts that'll up your elytras performance!
### Events

With seasonal events, there will always be something new to try out and fun to be made! Each event will have it's own elytra that you can show off and use to help with the tricky generation!

There is so much more than this, and the easiest way to discover is by playing for yourself!
